more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Isobutane is the branched-chain isomer of butane, supplied as a gas or liquefied gas. It supplies pressure used to expel food from a container. The specified material is supplied as colourless liquid or gas. EU permissions include vegetable oil pan spray.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain vegetable oil pan spray.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
